topic_en: Find the local extrema of f of x equals x cubed minus six x squared plus nine x. First, plot the function on axes. Second, compute the first derivative three x squared minus twelve x plus nine. Third, factor it as three times x minus one times x minus three. Fourth, set the derivative to zero and solve to get x equals one and x equals three. Fifth, compute the second derivative six x minus twelve. Sixth, evaluate at x equals one to get negative six, indicating a local maximum. Seventh, evaluate at x equals three to get positive six, indicating a local minimum. Finally, mark the points one comma four and three comma zero on the curve with horizontal tangent lines.
